headline: JRC reports uneven AI adoption across EU strategic sectors, with integration still shallow in many industries
summary: On 14 October 2026, the European Commission Joint Research Centre published an analysis mapping Eurostat ICT enterprise-survey data onto ten sectors in the EU Apply AI Strategy. The JRC reports that firm use of at least one AI technology in those strategic sectors rose from 7% in 2021 to 18% in 2025, versus 8% to 20% across broader EU economic areas. It reports higher uptake in media, energy and electronic communications, lower uptake in mobility, tourism and agri-food, and says much of the increase reflects accessible general-purpose tools used for text/audio and marketing or sales work. Skills shortages and regulatory uncertainty are reported as barriers. The account is based on JRC’s summary and report metadata; the research desk did not inspect the full report or recompute the sector estimates, and use rates do not establish productivity or production integration.
